subject: Bespoke commitment top-up escalation for VP/CFO signoff
messages:
From: Amelia Barnes <amelia@calibrate.health>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: interim top-up & pilot uplift

Hi Mateo,

Quick note from the product team — our pilot usage for the Conversational Triage workflow spiked last week as we onboarded an extra clinic cohort. We appear to be ~120% above the committed bucket for September and the team is asking whether Redwood can provide a short-term top-up or a temporary unit-rate concession while we stabilize.

High level:
- Current pilot: 250k tokens/day baseline; last 7 days average: 300k
- Unknown sustained: likely to hold at ~280k/day through October as clinics onboard

We're mid-negotiation for expanded contract (want committed capacity for Q1) but need a bridge so the usage spike doesn't trigger overage blocks for our ops team. Ideally we can get a one-time top-up credit + a temporary reduction on unit price for the next quarter to help us ramp.

Do you have flexibility? I can share the usage export if that helps. If possible we need an answer by EOD so procurement can align the amendment with our billing cutoff.

Thanks,
Amelia Barnes
Head of Product, Calibrate Health
Amelia@calibrate.health

Attachments: calibrate-usage-snapshot.pdf

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Barnes <amelia@calibrate.health>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: interim top-up & pilot uplift

Hi Amelia — thanks for the heads up and the snapshot. Im pulling a quick run-rate view and will escalate internally for an interim top-up and a short-term rate concession.

What I plan to do:
1) Propose a one-time credit to cover the delta through the end of September (rough estimate below).
2) Request an executive signoff for a 3-month reduced unit rate tied to a committed top-up and early renewal terms.

Prelim numbers (quick math):
- Delta (last 7 days) ~ 50k tokens/day * 23 remaining days = ~1.15M tokens.
- At our current rate this maps to roughly $6.9k incremental spend; allowance for buffer = propose $15k top-up credit + short-term unit reduction for Oct-Dec to smooth adoption.

Ill loop in Marissa and Finance for VP/CFO signoff — will get back to you by EOD with a concrete proposal and DocuSign link if approved.

Regards,
Mateo
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc:
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Escalation: Calibrate bespoke commitment top-up — VP/CFO signoff requested

Team,

Calibrate Health (pilot customer, strong expansion signals) just flagged a 20%+ usage spike while onboarding a second clinic cohort. Theyre asking for a short-term top-up and a temporary unit-rate concession to avoid operational overage blocks. Opportunity: theyre actively negotiating an expanded committed package (targeting $180k ARR uplift over 12 months if we secure the renewal). Risk: an inflexible stance could lead to a stalled renewal or a churned pilot.

Recommendation (what sales will execute if we get signoff):
- One-time top-up credit: $15,000 (covers usage delta + buffer through Sept).
- Temporary unit-rate concession: reduce to $0.006/token for the committed slab for Oct-Dec 2026 (3 months) provided they sign the attached amendment and commit to a 12-month renewal starting Jan 1 2027 at the proposed expanded commitment.
- Condition: amendment executed via DocuSign within 5 business days; failure to sign reverts pricing to standard and no further credits.

Impact analysis (approx):
- Revenue "forgone" in Q4 from concession (vs. standard list): ~$9k (estimated)
- One-time credit: $15k (P&L impact this quarter)
- Expected new ARR if renewal executed: ~$180k (net positive over 12 months)
- Payback horizon: ~3-4 months on incremental ARR assumption

Rationale: Calibrate is strategic in med-device integration and already running two paid pilots with separate BU leads; quick remediation will materially increase odds of committed expansion. Sales has buyers statement and procurement timeline (need amendment aligned with their billing cutoff — they requested answer by EOD).

Attachments: calibrate-map-usage-projection.xlsx, proposed-amendment.docx (summary and clause language for the top-up + 3-month concession).

Ask: Marissa — VP approval for the above structure and authorization to grant the one-time credit.
Kimberly — CFO acknowledgement of P&L impact and confirmation that we can proceed under standard finance carveout process.

Timebox: customer requested a decision by EOD PT; would like signoff or a call by 17:00 PT today.

Thanks,
Mateo

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 14:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Calibrate bespoke commitment top-up — VP/CFO signoff requested

Thanks Mateo — reviewed the context and projections. I approve a bridge but want to tighten downside:
- Adjust one-time top-up credit to $12,500 (instead of $15k) to limit immediate P&L exposure.
- Keep the 3-month unit-rate concession at $0.006/token, but add a clause: if Calibrate misses two consecutive months of commit by >25% post-renewal, the concession will be rescinded and a one-time clawback of 25% of the credit applied to the renewal invoice.

Kimberly: can Finance absorb $12.5k credit this quarter and sign off on the clawback language? If yes, Mateo — please finalize the amendment and route via DocuSign; copy me on the envelope.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales — Strategic Accounts
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Barnes <amelia@calibrate.health>, Procurement <procurement@calibrate.health>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 16:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: interim top-up & pilot uplift

Amelia — thank you for the patience. Summary of approved bridge (per internal signoff):

- One-time credit: $12,500 applied to September usage to cover the spike.
- Temporary unit-rate concession: $0.006/token on the committed slab for Oct-Dec 2026, contingent on executing the attached amendment.
- Clause: 25% clawback if post-renewal commit misses the agreed threshold in two consecutive months (per Marissa's note).

Next steps:
1) Ive attached the amendment and will send an official DocuSign envelope this afternoon. Please review and sign so billing can apply the credit before month-end.
2) Procurement, please confirm internal PO process and ETA on signature.

We appreciate the partnership — look forward to getting the new commit in place.

Best,
Mateo
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai

Attachments: proposed-amendment.docx
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/modify/CH-987
